srs_note: Point geometry. MUST pass outSR=4326 or geometry returns in Web Mercator (102100).
notes: Reference template (provided, confirmed working). Point events feed with species/date/count/waterbody/size.

srs_note: Point geometry, returned in wkid 4326 natively.
notes: Clean per-event point feed. Trout only (MD stocks trout). ActivityDate 1775581200000 = Apr 2026 (current season). No size field. Sibling service Fisheries/DNRTroutStocking returned HTTP 500 - use TroutStockingActivities.

srs_note: Point geometry 4326. Also has explicit Latitude/Longitude attribute fields. Also Pounds_stocked, NumberPerPound, StockYear, Strain, County, SpeciesCode.
notes: All species (not just trout). Rich fields. Host ndgishub.nd.gov is slow (first query timed out at 30s, succeeded on retry). Sample happened to be 2016; StockYear field spans many years - filter by StockYear for recent.

srs_note: POLYGON geometry (waterbody shape), not points. One feature per waterbody; all stocking events for that waterbody are an embedded JSON array string in STOCKING_RECORDS_JSON (parse it: year, species, strain, age_class, number_stocked, avg_fish_length_in, source_type, source_group).
notes: Rich recent data (2025 present). Events nested in STOCKING_RECORDS_JSON string per waterbody - requires client-side JSON parse but single request. Geometry is polygon not point; derive centroid if a point is needed. Records kept 15 yrs.

srs_note: NO geometry/lat-lon. Location is text only: waterbody, town, county. Would need geocoding against a waterbody gazetteer for points.
notes: Socrata SODA API; supports $where/$limit/$select. Covers 2011-2025 (DEC finalizes each year ~mid-May; current year absent until year-end). 'number' is an estimate. Count is an estimate per DEC. No geometry is the main gap.

srs_note: Sections layer is POLYLINE. 2026 service extent is NAD83 State Plane PA North (ft); 2024/2025 services use EPSG 4269. Point variant exists: PFBC_Stocked_Trout_Waters/MapServer/1 (STOCKED_TROUT_WATERS_PT).
notes: COULD NOT VERIFY VIA CURL: fbweb.pa.gov returns an HTML wall (WAF) for every request incl. f=json/f=pjson and /query, with browser UA too - no JSON obtainable server-side. Per service metadata the polyline sections are 'directly linked to tables of stocking events for trout' = related table join required for species/date/count. One service per year (TroutStocked2024/2025, TroutStockedSections_2026). Needs a real browser/session to extract; flag for manual check.

srs_note: Geometry and events are in SEPARATE layers. Geometry: layer 33 Trout Stocked Lakes centroids (86 pts, WATERBODY/LAKE_ID/lat-lon), layers 34/35 Trout Stocked Streams (midpoints/lines). Events/schedule: layer 38 'Trout Stocking Schedule (Streams and Rivers)' is a TABLE (no geometry): OBJECTID/PERIOD/DATES/NUM_TROUT/STREAM_ID. Join 38.STREAM_ID -> stream layer; lakes likely have a parallel schedule table.
notes: Trout only. Schedule table (layer 38) is only 22 rows (future/season schedule, not historical events). Species not in data (all trout). Needs STREAM_ID/LAKE_ID join to get geometry. Partial/low-value.

srs_note: Point geometry 4326; also LAT/LONG attribute fields. Fields: Hatchery, Watershed, Waterbody, Location, Town, Species (code e.g. BNT).
notes: PARTIAL - species+waterbody+point but NO stocking date and NO fish count. 'Fish Stocking Locations (2021)' static snapshot. Does not meet the events bar; marked none but URL kept (usable as which-species-stocked-where).

srs_note: Point geometry. Also VAFWIS/Stocked_Trout_Waters and Public/StockedTroutWaters and a Stocked_Trout_Reaches polyline variant.
notes: DESIGNATION layer only - which waters are in the catchable trout program + stocking-schedule category code (A/B/..), species as yes/no flags. NO per-event date or count. Does not meet events bar.

srs_note: Layer 6 Trout Lakes (points), layer 7 Trout Streams (polyline, STREAMNAME).
notes: Designation/location layers only (where trout are stocked) - name + regulation URL. No dates/counts/events.

srs_note: Point stocking-SITES layer (Site_Name, County, Water_Body, Town, TRS, Species) hosted on UMich server.
notes: Stocking SITES directory only, metadata vintage ~2000, no stocking dates or counts. Not an events feed. MI DNR FISHHUB services (services3.arcgis.com/Jdnp1TjADvSDxMAX) are hydrography/crosswalk layers, not events.

srs_note: POLYGON (waterbody rings), 4326. Fields: StockingWaterID, DFGWATERID, Counties, last_yr_stkd only.
notes: ds778 'Recent Stocked Waters' = polygons of waters stocked in last ~3 yrs with only last_yr_stkd + county. NO species, date, count, or waterbody name per record. Not an events feed. CDFW per-event planting data not found as a public machine feed (locations are generalized by policy).

No public machine-readable stocking feed found. CPW Fishing Atlas shows stocked waters but underlying service not surfaced; annual distribution schedule is PDF only. CNHP (colostate) services are species-distribution, not stocking. Check Fishing Atlas network requests for a hidden endpoint.
No WVDNR ArcGIS/API stocking feed found. Stocking published as web/PDF reports only.
No AZGFD stocking feature service found. Stocking schedule is a web tool only.

IDFG publishes Pheasant_Stocking, Fish_Hatcheries, and fishing-access layers but NO fish stocked-waters/events feed. gisportal-idfg.idaho.gov / gis.idfg.idaho.gov hosts; worth browsing Fisheries folder manually.
ODFW weekly trout stocking schedule is a myodfw.com web tool (week-level, 'subject to change'), no documented REST/GIS feed found.
No WDFW stocked-lakes/trout-plant ArcGIS FeatureServer surfaced. WDFW has a stocking web search; check its network calls and WDFW ArcGIS Hub.
No KDFWR stocking feature layer found. Only a USFWS Wolf Creek hatchery Hub record (no service URL).
No Georgia WRD stocking REST feed found.

TWRA stocking schedule is PDF + an ArcGIS Web AppBuilder viewer (twra.maps.arcgis.com). A feature service may sit behind the app (app id in the PDF) but no REST endpoint surfaced; flag for manual app-inspection.

Only trout-water CLASSIFICATION/regulation layers (NCWRC PMTW streams, DWR Trout Waters) - no stocking events (no dates/counts). NCWRC_Trout_Stream_Classes_in_NC_WFL1 FeatureServer exists but is regulation classes.
No TPWD stocking feature layer found.

DWR (dwrmapserv.utah.gov) publishes Aquatics_Community_Fisheries (locations) and admin FeatureServers but NO stocking-events layer surfaced. Stocking totals are news-release narrative. Browse Aquatics folder manually.
NM Dept Game & Fish posts weekly stocked-waters lists as web pages + an RSS fishing-report feed; no ArcGIS/API found.
CT DEEP stocking = weekly PDF report (and a Datawrapper table). CT ECO (cteco.uconn.edu) only has a DEEP property polygon layer, not stocking. No REST feed.
ODNR GIS (gis.ohiodnr.gov / gis2.ohiodnr.gov) exposes Lakes/Lands basemap layers only; no stocking-events service surfaced.
MN DNR (enterprise.gisdata.mn.gov) has fishing-sites, hatcheries, FiN ponds layers but no stocking-events layer surfaced. Worth browsing us_mn_state_dnr services for a stocking dataset.

NOT VERIFIABLE PUBLICLY: FWC Freshwater_Fish_Stocking_Table only appears on gistest.myfwc.com (a TEST host) which is unreachable from the server (connection timeout / firewalled). Production gis.myfwc.com Projects_FWC/Fish_Stocking_Locations_Map requires a token (HTTP 499 Token Required). No open public endpoint; flag for FWC contact.
